physicalNotes: Radius 0.11687057 Jupiter radii from Liu et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...72L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract): 8,355.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Liu et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...72L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01667566 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
